papers.title: Long-term nitrogen deposition drives phosphorus allocation and phoD -harboring bacterial community dynamics in dryland ecosystems
papers.recommendationReason: 重点体现导师方向；命中“nitrogen deposition”等信号。

essence.problem: Abstract The phoD-harboring bacteria play a crucial role in regulating organic phosphorus (Po) mineralization in soil.
essence.design: Here, we used a 13-yr field experiment in the Gurbantunggut Desert to disentangle the effects of long-term N deposition on phoD-mediated P cycling across moss and lichen biocrusts under contrasting seasonal conditions.
essence.innovation: The results reveal that moss crusts had significantly higher concentrations of labile inorganic phosphorus (Pi), labile Po, and available P compared to lichen crusts.
essence.limitations: 以上内容基于公开摘要；样本范围、统计细节与因果边界需阅读全文核验。
